The '''Velmorians''' were the [[Human/Legends|Human]] inhabitants of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Velmor/Legends|Velmor]]. They shared the world with its indigenous [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Velmoc]]s.
